name: dealshield-extension
description: DealShield AI Chrome Extension — real-time sales negotiation inside Gmail

scripts.build: npm run clean && vite build && vite build --mode content
scripts.build:local: npm run clean && vite build --mode development && vite build --mode content
scripts.dev: npm run clean && concurrently -k -n app,content "vite build --watch --mode development" "vite build --watch --mode content"
